raw_segments.text: But Dmitry Fyodorovich was speeding along the road.
It was a little more than twenty verse to Makro, but Andri's three horses galloped
at such a pace that the distance might be covered in an hour and a quarter.
The air was fresh and cool, there were big stars shining in the sky.
It was the very night, and perhaps the very hour, in which Alyosha fell on the earth and
rapturously swore to love it forever and ever.
